text.text: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
Of an unclean thing what can be cleansed? and from that thing which is false what truth can come?
Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
